sources.name: BusElche / Avanza official route pages for radial Lines R4, R5 and R6
Current AliBus ordered R4, R5 and R6 stop pages with municipal stop codes and map coordinates
Uploaded municipal-style route diagrams for R4 and R5
Accepted elche-legacy-all-v1 and elche-radial-inner-v1 used for exact StopNode and StopPlace identity reuse

transformations.description: Combines each current Ida and Vuelta stop list into one complete vehicle cycle. Repeated directional handoff and initial cycle-boundary occurrences are removed; closesLoop=true adds the final edge once.
Uses municipal stop code as the stable elche-stop and elche-place suffix. Existing codes are copied exactly from the accepted Elche identity registry.
Creates one strict parser-compatible StopPlace for each new radial StopNode. No proximity-only physical merges are made.
Writes scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and registers the scenario.

warnings: Runtime StopNode sourceReferences remain empty for new radial nodes because that field accepts only genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position components. Municipal codes and map-link coordinates remain build provenance.
Accepted StopNode and StopPlace objects reused from earlier Elche scenarios retain their exact previous bytes and coordinates.
R4 revisits elche-stop-088 and R5 revisits elche-stop-024 at non-consecutive positions in their complete vehicle cycles.
R4 and R5 contain many physically close opposite-side road stops with distinct municipal codes. They remain separate StopNodes and singleton StopPlaces.
R6 has no uploaded diagram in the supplied radial archive. Its route order is based on the current textual route source and official route identity.
Physical StopPlace creation does not create route edges, reverse patterns, or cross-pattern graph edges.
